PR #1775 deletes libmavconn/cmake/Modules/FindGeographicLib.cmake (which searched "find_library (GeographicLib_LIBRARIES NAMES Geographic)") and adds to mavros/CMakeLists.txt "set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH \"${CMAKE_MODULE_PATH};/usr/share/cmake/geographiclib\")" so that the find module shipped by GeographicLib is used. PR text: "The `FindGeographicLib.cmake` is already shipped with the distribution through the geographiclib package, hence our custom one (which seems to fail for later geographiclib versions) is not needed anymore." GeographicLib's 2.0 change notes state "Library file now called libGeographicLib.so, etc., instead of libGeographic.so."
